sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A FAIRLY LOW AMPLITUDE PROGRESSIVE PATTERN WILL PREVAIL OVER THE LWR 48 THIS PERIOD...WITH MN UPR LOW CONTINUING ENE TO THE ONT/QUE BORDER AS UPSTREAM SYSTEM MOVES FROM WA/ORE TO NW WY. A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ROTATING AROUND MN SYSTEM WILL REACH LK MI THIS EVE AND THE LWR GRT LKS EARLY THU...ACCELERATING OH VLY COLD FRONT EWD ACROSS NY/PA EARLY THU. IN THE WEST...STRONG COLD FRONT WITH WA/ORE SYSTEM WILL MOVE ESE ACROSS THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION TODAY AND INTO THE RCKYS TONIGHT.

sections.title: OH VLY/LWR GRT LKS
sections.text: A CURRENT OF WARM BUT COMPARATIVELY DRY PRE-FRONTAL AIR WILL SWEEP NE ACROSS THE OH VLY AND LWR GRT LKS TODAY/TONIGHT BENEATH 50+ KT WSWLY MID LVL FLOW ON SERN FRINGE OF STRONG...PROGRESSIVE UPR TROUGH. THE COOLEST AIR ALOFT WILL REMAIN N OF ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT IN NRN MI. BUT RELATIVELY COOL MID LVL TEMPERATURES /AROUND MINUS 15C AT 500 MB/ WILL BE PRESENT AHEAD OF THE BOUNDARY...WHERE STRONG SFC HEATING AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S SHOULD BOOST SBCAPE TO 500-1000 J/KG FROM ERN IL ENE INTO MUCH OF OH. ALTHOUGH THE STRONGEST FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REMAIN OVER THE UPR GRT LKS THROUGH MOST OF THE PERIOD...COMBINATION OF SFC HEATING AND FRONTAL UPLIFT WILL SUPPORT AFTN/EVE TSTMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT. LONG...SLIGHTLY CURVED HODOGRAPHS /WITH 30 KT SWLY LOW LVL FLOW VEERING TO 50+ KT WLY FLOW AT 500 MB/...COUPLED WITH EXPECTED INSTABILITY AND LIKELIHOOD FOR SIZABLE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS IN THE PBL...SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR SCTD SUSTAINED STORMS WITH SVR WIND/HAIL. THE STORMS COULD ORGANIZE INTO BKN LINE SEGMENTS WITH SMALL BOWS THAT CONTINUE EWD INTO WRN NY/NW PA THROUGH THE EVE. BUT THE SVR THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH AS THE RELATIVELY DRY PREFRONTAL AIR QUICKLY COOLS.

sections.title: PAC NW INTO NRN GRT BASIN
sections.text: COLD MID LVL TEMPS /-30 TO -34 C AT 500 MB/ WILL ACCOMPANY UPR LOW OVER THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION THIS AFTN/EVE. SFC HEATING WITHIN THE POST-FRONTAL ENVIRONMENT WILL RESULT IN STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES...WITH SCTD SHOWERS AND TSTMS EXPECTED. THESE COULD YIELD SMALL HAIL/GUSTY WINDS. FARTHER SE...WEAK BUOYANCY ALSO WILL EXIST AHEAD OF FRONT OVER NRN UT/SW WY/NW CO...WHERE ISOLD GUSTY EVE STORMS COULD OCCUR IN REGION FAST WSWLY FLOW. ..CORFIDI/GARNER.. 05/05/2010

sections.title: OH VLY/LWR GRT LKS
sections.text: MODEL GUIDANCE IS IN VERY GOOD AGREEMENT THAT PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTION WILL DEVELOP AND SPREAD EAST INTO MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /SBCAPE AROUND 1000 J PER KG/ FROM NRN IND INTO SERN LOWER MI AND NWRN OH LATER THIS AFTERNOON. INCREASINGLY STRONG MID LEVEL FLOW WILL CONTRIBUTE TO 30-50KT BULK SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED/PERSISTENT STORMS WITH HAIL AND WIND. INITIAL DISCRETE STORMS COULD PRODUCE A FEW LARGE HAIL EVENTS BEFORE STORMS FURTHER ORGANIZE INTO LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS AND POSE A GREATER CHANCE OF DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN MODEST TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER. EXPECTED INSTABILITY AND SOME LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPH CURVATURE COULD ALSO LEAD TO A BRIEF TORNADO...ESPECIALLY NEAR ANY FAVORABLY ORIENTED LAKE BREEZE/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. SQUALL LINE WITH FAST-MOVING SMALL BOWS AND SOME WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD INTO WRN NY/NW PA THROUGH THE EVE. HOWEVER...SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD SUBSIDE AS DIURNAL COOLING SETS IN AND SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY WEAKENS.

sections.title: PAC NW
sections.text: NEXT UPPER TROUGH WITH VERY COLD AIR ALOFT WILL SPREAD INLAND ACROSS WA/ORE/ID THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON. LIFT WITH THE LOW AND DIMINISHING STATIC STABILITY...COUPLED WITH OROGRAPHIC LIFT AND HEATING SHOULD LEAD TO LOW-TOPPED CONVECTION. A FEW OF THE MORE VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS MAY BE CAPABLE OF GENERATING SMALL HAIL AND GUSTY SURFACE WINDS BUT OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT APPEARS ISOLATED AND OF RELATIVELY LOW PROBABILITY. ..CARBIN/STOPPKOTTE.. 05/05/2010

sections.title: OH VALLEY THROUGH LOWER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: FORECAST APPEARS ON TRACK WITH MINIMAL CHANGES NEEDED. ATMOSPHERE IS DESTABILIZING SOUTH OF COLD FRONT THAT STRETCHES FROM SRN LOWER MI...NWRN IND INTO CNTRL IL. STORMS WILL INCREASE ALONG THE FRONT AND PRE-FRONTAL CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY ACROSS THE OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. UNIDIRECTIONAL 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 40-45 KT WILL SUPPORT A THREAT OF SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS. STORMS WILL DEVELOP EWD THROUGH WRN NY AND NWRN PA THIS EVENING. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS. REFERENCE SWOMCD 481 FOR MORE DETAILS. ..DIAL.. 05/05/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT WED MAY 05 2010/
